article.headline: Utah Valley opens the season with an 84-63 win over Western Colorado
article.description: — Isaac Davis scored 22 points as Utah Valley began its season Monday with an 84-63 victory over Western Colorado.
article.linkText: Utah Valley opens the season with an 84-63 win over Western Colorado

event.description: Western Colorado Mountaineers @ Utah Valley Wolverines

keywords: Western Colorado Mountaineers @ Utah Valley Wolverines
article.story: OREM, Utah -- — Isaac Davis scored 22 points as Utah Valley began its season Monday with an 84-63 victory over Western Colorado. Davis also contributed three steals for the Wolverines. Dominick Nelson scored 16 points while going 6 for 11 from the field and 4 for 8 from the free-throw line, and added five rebounds and four steals. Braden Housley went 4 for 9 from the field to finish with eight points. Petar Strugar led the way for the Mountaineers with 15 points. DeMarion Yap added 11 points for Western Colorado. Quincy Scott finished with 10 points, four assists and three steals. Up next Utah Valley visits Weber State on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
